No. 359 of 1939.
Civilian Residence & Consulate-General.
Bradite, the 15th February 1939.

Two copies of the undermentioned paper are
forwarded to:

The Political Agent, Muost.
The Political Agent, Haddin.
The Political Agent, Kuwait.

For favour of giving wide publicity to the Proclamation.

By Order,
Major,
Secretary to the Political Resident
In the Persian Quilt.
